author: Karl Rock
description:
Most people think alcohol is completely banned in Pakistan… but that’s only half the story.

While it’s illegal for Muslims, foreigners and religious minorities (like Hindus and Christians) can still buy alcohol legally under certain conditions. So what does that actually look like on the ground?

In this video, I went searching for one of these hidden alcohol stores - and what I found surprised me.

From strict Islamic laws to discreet liquor shops operating in plain sight, this is a side of Pakistan most people never see.

Watch till the end to understand how the system really works in 2026.
title: Alcohol Is Banned in Pakistan… Right?
